question: Which of the following elements is responsible for high Blood Pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The element primarily responsible for **high blood pressure is sodium**.
 
• Eating too much sodium, **which is found in table salt**, can directly contribute to increased blood pressure. 
 
• When sodium levels in the blood rise,** it can lead to increased water retention**
 
• The atomic number of** sodium is 11. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Element
 Role in Blood Pressure Regulation
 Sources
 
 

 Potassium
 Helps balance sodium levels in the body, relaxes blood vessel walls, and reduces strain on the cardiovascular system.
 Bananas, oranges, potatoes, spinach, avocados, beans, and sweet potatoes.
 
 

 Calcium
 Supports proper blood vessel contraction and relaxation, contributing to stable blood pressure.
 Dairy products, leafy greens (like kale and broccoli), almonds, and tofu.
 
 

 Magnesium
 Relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, playing a critical role in maintaining normal blood pressure.
 Nuts, seeds, whole grains, spinach, dark chocolate, and legumes.
